root_cause_label: Incomplete ELF section extraction with wrong section scope and zero-value filtering
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent arbitrarily limited ELF extraction to only four named sections (.data, .rodata, .got, .dynamic) and additionally filtered out zero values, missing the .text section and all code-segment bytes, leading to insufficient coverage without ever validating against expected output.
t_err_evidence: At step 10, agent wrote extract.js with targetSections = ['.data', '.rodata', '.got', '.dynamic'], explicitly excluding .text and other loadable segments, based on an unverified assumption about which sections contain the required memory values.
t_commit_evidence: At step 12, agent rewrote extract.js retaining the same four-section scope and adding a zero-value filter (if (value !== 0)), cementing the wrong extraction strategy; subsequent steps only tested consistency of this flawed implementation.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed without verification that only .data, .rodata, .got, and .dynamic sections contain the required memory values. After viewing objdump section listings, the agent formed this belief from selective manual inspection rather than checking the task specification or a reference solution, causing it to exclude .text and all code-segment data.
